en-US.building-variant.CircuitsLatch.title: Latch
en-US.building-variant.CircuitsLatch.descripti: <gl>Holds</gl> the last signal on its Data input until <gl>Reset</gl> is on. Captures any truthy value: 1, a shape or a color.
en-US.toolbar.circuits-integrated-circuits.des: Design circuits on an <gl>IC Board</gl>, build them into <gl>firmware</gl>, and run them on IC chips.
en-US.building-variant.CircuitsICPackage1x1.de: Runs <gl>firmware</gl> built from an <gl>IC Board</gl>. Each side is an input or an output, depending on the firmware. Flash firmware onto it from its panel.
en-US.building-variant.CircuitsICPackage2x1.de: Runs <gl>firmware</gl> built from a 2x1 <gl>IC Board</gl>. Each of its six connections is an input or an output, depending on the firmware. Flash firmware onto it from its panel.
en-US.building-variant.CircuitsICPackage2x2.de: Runs <gl>firmware</gl> built from a 2x2 <gl>IC Board</gl>. Each of its eight connections is an input or an output, depending on the firmware. Flash firmware onto it from its panel.
en-US.building-variant.CircuitsICInputNotchPin: Marks an <gl>input</gl> of an <gl>IC Board</gl>. Fills one of the board's notches: that side of the chip becomes an input. The wire connects at its end; <gl>F</gl> flips which end. On the board it sends its <gl>test value</gl>, set like a Constant Signal.
en-US.building-variant.CircuitsICOutputNotchPi: Marks an <gl>output</gl> of an <gl>IC Board</gl>. Fills one of the board's notches: that side of the chip becomes an output. The wire connects at its end; <gl>F</gl> flips which end. On the board it shows what reaches it.
en-US.building-variant.CircuitsICInputPin.desc: Marks an <gl>input</gl> of an <gl>IC Board</gl>. Place it in a notch or on the edge: that side of the package becomes an input. On the board it sends its <gl>test value</gl>, set like a Constant Signal.
en-US.building-variant.CircuitsICOutputPin.des: Marks an <gl>output</gl> of an <gl>IC Board</gl>. Place it in a notch or on the edge: that side of the package becomes an output. On the board it shows what reaches it.
en-US.island-layout.CircuitsICBoard.title: IC Board 1x1
en-US.island-layout.CircuitsICBoard.descriptio: A platform for designing <gl>integrated circuits</gl>. Holds only signal buildings. Mark its inputs and outputs with <gl>IC Pins</gl>, then select the board and <gl>Build</gl> it into firmware from its panel.
en-US.island-layout.CircuitsICBoard2x1.title: IC Board 2x1
en-US.island-layout.CircuitsICBoard2x1.descrip: A two-chunk platform for designing <gl>integrated circuits</gl> for 2x1 chips, with six notches for <gl>IC Pins</gl>. Holds only signal buildings. Select the board and <gl>Build</gl> it into firmware from its panel.
en-US.island-layout.CircuitsICBoard2x2.title: IC Board 2x2
en-US.island-layout.CircuitsICBoard2x2.descrip: A four-chunk platform for designing <gl>integrated circuits</gl> for 2x2 chips, with eight notches for <gl>IC Pins</gl>. Holds only signal buildings. Select the board and <gl>Build</gl> it into firmware from its panel.
en-US.toolbar.circuits-ic-boards.title: IC Boards
en-US.toolbar.circuits-ic-boards.description: Platforms for designing <gl>integrated circuits</gl>, one per chip size. Build a board into <gl>firmware</gl> and flash it onto IC chips.
en-US.toolbar.circuits-integer-gates.title: Integer Gates
en-US.toolbar.circuits-integer-gates.descripti: Gates that work on the whole <gl>number</gl> a wire carries, 32 bits of it: pack many flags into one wire and pick them out again.
en-US.building-variant.CircuitsBitwiseGate.des: Combines the <gl>bits</gl> of two numbers: AND, OR or XOR, picked in its panel. AND with a constant <gl>masks</gl> bits out. A from the west, B from the north, the result to the east.
en-US.building-variant.CircuitsNotGate.title: Bitwise NOT
en-US.building-variant.CircuitsNotGate.descrip: Flips every <gl>bit</gl> of a number (0 becomes -1). In from the west, the result to the east.
en-US.building-variant.CircuitsShiftGate.title: Shift Gate
en-US.building-variant.CircuitsShiftGate.descr: Moves a number's <gl>bits</gl> left or right, picked in its panel, by the amount from the north; right fills with zeros. Value from the west, the result to the east.
<gl>Adds</gl> or <gl>subtracts</gl> two numbers, picked in its panel. A from the west, B from the north, the result to the east.
